thesis: The speaker describes her early research on the interbank foreign exchange market, which concluded that price discovery was primarily driven by smaller banks rather than larger institutions. She explains that larger banks could balance trades internally to avoid revealing information, whereas smaller players were the ones actively updating market prices.
